penalties.details: Penalty of Rs. 10,000 imposed in relation to an alleged shortfall in fulfilment of export obligations pertaining to FY 2019-20 by Strides Alathur Private Limited, former wholly-owned subsidiary of Strides, which merged with Strides effective September 12, 2024. Additionally, the name of Strides Alathur is included in the Denied Entity List (DEL) maintained by DGFT. Further the order states that no further licenses / authorizations/ export incentives shall be granted to the licensee and to its Director(s) and to other business entities in which they are directly involved in the capacity of Proprietor/ Propreitrix/ Partners)/ Director(s).
penalties.impact: Penalty of Rs. 10,000/- has been paid by the Company. Further, Strides has filed an appeal before the Additional Director General of Foreign Trade seeking withdrawal of all the charges in the Order including penalty imposed. Based on current assessment, there is no financial or material impact on the operational or financial activities of Strides.

operating_notes.text: Venkata Seetharama Raju Pakalapati appointed Executive Director and KMP effective June 1, 2026.
Aditya Arun Kumar redesignated as Non-Executive Director effective June 1, 2026.
US revenue was $68m in Q1FY27, steady YoY despite new entrants in recent launches; 72 commercialised products, 2 launched in the quarter.
228 ANDAs filed and 210 approved (152 products) as of June 2026; second nasal spray product filed in May 2026.
Net debt/EBITDA at 1.52x with operating cash flow of ₹1,087m in Q1FY27; cash-to-cash cycle 123 days.
Ex-US quarterly revenue (₹696.3 Cr) surpassed US revenue (₹685.5 Cr) for the first time in Q2FY27.
230 ANDAs filed, 212 approved (154 products) as of Oct 2026; 75 commercialised in US.
Net Debt/EBITDA stood at 1.72x as of Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: Strides Pharma Science Limited scheduled an earnings call on May 18, 2026, at 17:00 IST for investors and analysts to discuss audited Q4FY26 results, led by Managing Director & Group CEO Badree Komandur Vikesh Kumar and Group CFO Vikesh Kumar.
Strides Pharma Science Limited’s **Manjula Ramamurthy** corrected the US earnings call time from 6:30 AM EST to **7:30 AM EDT** on May 18, 2026.
Strides Pharma Science reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹4,858.7 Cr and operational PAT of ₹518.1 Cr, recommending a dividend of ₹5 per share.
Strides Pharma recommended the appointment of Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP as statutory auditors for a five-year term starting from the 2027 AGM.
Strides Pharma Science Limited shared the earnings call recording for Q4FY26 and FY26 results via its website on May 18, 2026, at 17:00 hrs IST.
Strides Pharma Science announced NCLT Bengaluru Bench approval for the demerger of Arco Lab's life sciences and digital innovation businesses into Pivot Path.
Strides Pharma announced board and management changes effective June 1, 2026, including elevating Ramaraju PVS to Executive Director and redesignating Aditya Arun Kumar as Non-Executive Director.
Strides Pharma announced the completion of a USFDA inspection at its Bangalore flagship facility with five observations on May 20, 2026.
Pronomz Ventures LLP, on behalf of Strides Pharma Science Limited’s promoters, disclosed no new encumbrances on shares under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) as of April 7, 2026.
Strides Pharma announced the effective date of June 1, 2026, for the demerger involving Arco Lab and Pivot Path following ROC filing of the NCLT order.

Q1FY27 (Jul 31, 2026): Strides reported revenue of ₹1,265 Cr (+13% YoY), EBITDA of ₹230 Cr (+5.4%), reported PAT of ₹166 Cr (+56.7%) including a ₹632m exceptional gain on the Pivot Path stake sale; net debt ₹14,246m at 1.52x EBITDA.
Strides Pharma reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹1,429.7 Cr (+17.1% YoY) and shifted its ~$375m US revenue target beyond FY28.
Audio recording of the earnings call for unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 was made available on the company’s website on October 30, 2026.
